reason: An independent code audit after the initial M1 run identified required corrections to conditional permutation and equal-n terminology, and confirmed nonrandom target attrition in high-depth sensitivity analyses.

affected_decisions.value: Freedman-Lane residual permutation on rank-transformed dependency after fitting the prespecified covariates
affected_decisions.rationale: Permuting dependency directly destroys its existing relationship with covariates; conditional association testing should retain the reduced-model fitted component.

value: median and 2.5th-97.5th percentiles of replicate-wise Spearman rho
Spearman rho of the per-target expected equal-n shift with target bootstrap CI
affected_decisions.rationale: The two estimands answer different questions and require distinct names; expected-shift rho must not be called replicate-average rho.

affected_decisions.value: association between per-target expected equal-n shift at depth 20 and dependency
affected_decisions.rationale: The initial code implemented this definition before results were generated; the Gate definition is not switched after observing results. The complete replicate-wise rho distribution is also reported.

affected_decisions.value: within each context, freeze targets with at least 100 perturbed cells and reuse that identical target set at depths 20, 25, 50 and 100; 1000 repeats per depth
affected_decisions.rationale: Separate changes in sampling depth from nonrandom target attrition as thresholds change.

affected_decisions.value: standardized OLS with HC3 robust uncertainty for raw or noise-corrected shift as outcome and dependency plus log target-cell count as predictors
affected_decisions.rationale: Add the parsimonious linear sensitivity promised in the frozen plan, without expanding to a high-dimensional covariate model.

affected_decisions.value: hash raw MTX, barcode, feature, protospacer-call, primary DepMap endpoint, frozen registry and amendments
affected_decisions.rationale: M1 equal-n and matched-null analyses depend directly on raw cell-level inputs, which must be recorded in the run manifest.

results_status_at_amendment: Initial M1 outputs had been generated and inspected; the dual-context Gate decision was STOP_AND_REASSESS.
outcome_awareness_statement: These changes correct conditional permutation, remove ambiguity in estimands, and separate target attrition; analyses are not selected for a more favorable bridge effect. Original outputs and the v1.0 registry are retained.
